# RangeCircle

**Category:** Render  
**Aliases:** RangeCircle

## What it does

Draws a circle at your feet indicating your hit range

Description basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/RangeCircle.html). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).
